title: Selling Plans Rate Table — Level Discount Rates for Discount Dispute Credits
content:
For a discount dispute credit on **Selling Plans**, the level discount rate is set by the seller's performance level on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record and, at Top Rated Level, by whether the disputed order shipped through Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN). The level discount rate sets the discount dispute rate the credit is worked at.

## Which level counts

The performance level of a discount dispute credit is the level in force on the disputed fee record's date: the level recorded at the seller's latest standing evaluation when that evaluation is dated on or before the fee's date; when the latest evaluation is dated after the fee's date, no level in force on that date is on record and the level discount rate is the standard top-rated discount rate (the plan's top-rated final value fee discount rate).

## Rate table

The level discount rate of a discount dispute credit is the partner discount rate when the seller's performance level is Preferred Partner Level, the top-rated FBN discount rate when the level is Top Rated Level and an FBN outbound shipment is recorded for the disputed order, and the standard top-rated discount rate for any other seller.

| Performance level in force on the fee's date | FBN outbound shipment recorded for the disputed order | Level discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| Preferred Partner Level | Either | Partner discount rate: 15% |
| Top Rated Level | Yes | Top-rated FBN discount rate: 12% |
| Top Rated Level | No | The plan's top-rated final value fee discount rate |
| Any other level, or no level in force on that date on record | Either | The plan's top-rated final value fee discount rate |

## Cases on hypothetical records

- **Evaluation after the fee.** The fee record is dated 10 May; the latest standing evaluation, dated 1 June, records Preferred Partner Level. That evaluation is dated after the fee's date, so no level in force on 10 May is on record, and the level discount rate is the plan's top-rated final value fee discount rate.
- **Evaluation on the fee's date.** The fee record is dated 1 June and the latest evaluation, dated 1 June, records Preferred Partner Level: the level is in force on the fee's date and the rate is 15%.
- **Top Rated Level, FBN shipment on record.** The latest evaluation, dated before the fee, records Top Rated Level, and the FBN activity shows an outbound shipment for the disputed order: the rate is 12%.
